# Keys of app/config/deploy/.env that the Deploy workflow may write from the GitHub environment (TE-19, #1013).
# Format: <KEY> <var|secret>. `var` comes from the environment's variables, `secret` from its secrets (masked in logs).
# Every key of .env.example is listed here or in the exclusion list of app/tools/dev/tests/deploy/apply-env.test.mjs, so a new
# key forces a decision. Names that are not listed are never sent to the host.
DB_OWNER_USER var
DB_OWNER_PASSWORD secret
APP_URL var
AUTH_URL var
APP_HOST var
AUTH_HOST var
CADDY_SCHEME var
TRUSTED_PROXIES var
HTTP_PORT var
HTTPS_PORT var
KEYCLOAK_DB_PASSWORD secret
KEYCLOAK_DB_NAME var
KEYCLOAK_DB_USER var
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USER var
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD secret
KEYCLOAK_JAVA_HEAP var
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PORT var
SMTP_HOST var
SMTP_PORT var
SMTP_FROM var
SMTP_AUTH var
SMTP_USER var
SMTP_PASSWORD secret
SMTP_STARTTLS var
SMTP_SSL var
MAIL_UI_USER var
MAIL_UI_HASH secret
TS_APP_NAME var
TS_AUTH_NAME var
TS_TAG var
COMPOSE_FILE var
BACKUP_DIR var
BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS var
BACKUP_REMOTE var
CATALOG_FILL var
ATTRIBUTE_FILL var
TAXONOMY_BUILD var
FEATURES var
